race.description: Maranoa Regional Council/Nutrien Harcourts Mdn Plate
race.comment: READY AS BAM (3) is the clear starting point after being beaten a neck in a Mdn at Toowoomba, where he began well, held his spot and was only collared late. He now comes back from provincial company, and he looks the one to beat on his recent form. JEWEL OF THE SEA (11) is the dangerous debutant, having won a comfortable Toowoomba Inner Track trial for a stable with a strong debut record; the barrier is awkward, but the readiness signals are better than most first starters here. DISCO DIAMOND (10) won't be far away and OUTAGES (2) might be one to watch with the blinkers tried this time around.
